description:
View recent webhook delivery history. Shows which events were delivered, HTTP status codes, and timing.

Pass agent_id to see deliveries for that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to see deliveries for that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

hours.description: Only include deliveries from the last N hours. If omitted, deliveries are returned regardless of age.

limit.description: How many of the most recent deliveries to return. If omitted, the 20 most recent are returned.

name: list_webhook_deliveries

outputSchema.description: A page of webhook delivery history.

responseMs.description: Your endpoint's response time in ms, or null.

statusCode.description: HTTP status your endpoint returned, or null.

hasMore.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: List Webhook Deliveries
